verdict.rationale: A published OpenAPI specification that generates client libraries (gh-1) and documented account and transaction data elements grouped by account type (docs-8, docs-31) give machine-readable, documented schemas. Transaction insights such as transaction types, recurring transactions, consumer spending and loan payments (docs-22) supply enrichment a workflow can reason over. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of a JSON response format and examples of field-level schema detail, documentation of the enrichment output structure (categories, confidence fields), and independent or hands-on evidence that responses are clean enough to use without heuristic parsing.
